title: Reliance, Rolls-Royce partner to develop engine for India's fifth-gen fighter jet
content: In a joint statement, the two companies said they would explore setting up an Aerospace Gas Turbine Complex in India. The proposed facility would aim to develop expertise across the entire engine lifecycle, including design, development, manufacturing, testing, production and long-term maintenance and support. The partnership would bring together Rolls-Royce's experience in aero-engine technology with Reliance's capabilities in technology, manufacturing and project execution.

title: 'You’re not in Bangladesh now': Starc, Mehidy Hasan clash during Darwin Test - Watch
content: The incident took place during Starc's 21st over, the 103rd over of Bangladesh's innings. Miraz hit the ball towards point and set off for a single, but while following the ball, appeared to run through the protected area in the middle of the pitch.

title: 'India can take risks, hit hard': NSA says message to world clear after Op Sindoor
content: National Security Adviser Ajit Doval conveyed India's strong stance against adversaries.  Operation Sindoor was launched after a terror attack in Pahalgam.  India conducted precision strikes on terror infrastructure in Pakistan and Pakistan-administered Kashmir.  The operation demonstrated India's military superiority and willingness to act decisively.  This action concluded an 88-hour conflict, forcing Pakistan to seek peace.

title: Zohran Mamdani’s ‘common sense regulation’ may push Amazon to move NYC deliveries
content: In a bold move, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has shown support for a groundbreaking bill that mandates direct employment for delivery drivers, aiming to eliminate subcontracting and bolster the rights of workers. However, Amazon has raised concerns, indicating the bill may drive its operations outside of the city.

title: Independence Day: Best messages, quotes, wishes & images to share
content: In 2026, India will commemorate its 80th Independence Day on a Saturday, starting with a heartfelt flag hoisting ceremony led by the Prime Minister. The nation's vibrancy shines through as homes and public spaces are adorned with the tricolor, embodying the Har Ghar Tiranga campaign. This piece provides inspiring suggestions for messages, quotes, and shareable images to enhance your celebration and spread joy on social platforms.

title: India's forex reserves climb to $707 billion, mark $14.1 billion jump
content: India's foreign exchange reserves jumped a notable $14.136 billion, reaching a total of $707.002 billion for the week ending August 7. This surge was largely driven by a $9.946 billion rise in foreign currency assets, complemented by a $3.995 billion increase in gold reserves. These noteworthy gains come on the heels of strategic initiatives from the government and the RBI aimed at boosting foreign exchange inflows.

title: Watch: UP thief checks in, bathes & dances in bike showroom before the real act
content: A Varanasi thief entered a motorcycle showroom before midnight and stayed for hours. He used the showroom's facilities, including water and coffee, before changing clothes. The intruder then selected a premium motorcycle and rode away with accessories. Police are investigating the incident and circulating the suspect's photograph. The thief's leisurely actions were captured on extensive CCTV footage.

title: US Labor official slams H-1B program, blames govt and companies, not workers
content: Inspector General Anthony D’Esposito is conducting an in-depth investigation into the H-1B visa program, highlighting its potential exploitation of American workers. He characterizes the program as a criminal enterprise. This investigation, part of a broader task force, seeks to expose various inter-state crimes. A new rule could require H-1B visa holders, upon job loss, to leave the United States immediately, erasing their previous grace period.

title: Focus on Galle, eye on The Oval: 'Goal is to play WTC final,' says Shubman Gill
content: Shubman Gill's World Test Championship (WTC) mission begins in Galle, where India need a strong run of results to keep their hopes of reaching next year's final alive. With the captain stressing the importance of preparation, India head into the series opener against Sri Lanka with a rejigged squad, a potential three-spin attack and their eyes firmly on The Oval, where the final of the WTC will be played

title: London river declared biologically dead in 1957 now has sharks and seals
content: The River Thames in London has made a remarkable recovery, evolving from a biologically barren stretch to a vibrant ecosystem full of life, such as sharks and seals. This revitalization is attributed to decades of pollution management and enhanced sewage systems. The Thames Tideway Tunnel plays a crucial role in minimizing sewage discharge. However, challenges like warming waters and nitrate pollution still pose threats.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott is leading the charge in medical debt relief, having made groundbreaking donations that freed over $40 billion for families burdened by this often overwhelming responsibility. Her innovative approach, which involves acquiring debt at minimal costs for cancellation, has inspired other billionaires to make similar contributions. Yet, the call for broader policy reform lingers, revealing the constraints of this philanthropic model.

title: Video: Woman damages gear worth Rs 49k at Bhubaneswar airport after flight cancelled
content: Bhubaneswar airport authorities filed a police complaint against a disruptive woman passenger.  She allegedly damaged airport property after her IndiGo flight cancellation on Thursday.  The passenger created a ruckus in the departure lounge, causing significant damage.  Airport officials and CISF personnel witnessed the unruly passenger's actions.  Police are investigating the incident and seeking cost recovery for the damaged equipment.

title: China's new carriers have an old enemy to deal with - submarines
content: China's growing aircraft carrier fleet faces significant submarine threats. Adversaries like the US and Japan possess advanced submarines capable of undetected attacks. China's anti-submarine warfare capabilities show persistent gaps in tracking hostile vessels. Beijing's carriers are moving further into the Pacific, increasing their exposure. This strategic shift aims to project power but heightens vulnerability to ambushes.

title: Why Britain's grass is turning yellow after its driest month ever
content: After experiencing the driest July on record, England's picturesque green fields have succumbed to a fading yellow hue. This alarming trend of increasing heatwaves significantly affects lawns and public parks. While native grasses possess resilience during droughts and can deepen their roots to conserve water, extended dry periods inevitably lead them to enter a dormant state, awaiting rain.

title: BJP MP Anil Baluni has narrow escape as boulder crashes onto car near Rishikesh
content: Garhwal MP Anil Baluni narrowly escaped a falling boulder near Totaghati. The massive rock fell from the hillside onto his Innova car. He was traveling to assess the situation following a tunnel accident. Fortunately, no one inside the vehicle sustained serious injuries. The car sustained damage from the boulder's impact.

title: Nigel Farage beats ‘space warrior trashcan’ rival in UK by-poll he triggered
content: Nigel Farage claimed a decisive win in the Clacton parliamentary by-election, following his resignation amid controversies surrounding his financial dealings. His nearest rival, the comedic character Count Binface, surprisingly garnered a considerable share of support. Meanwhile, prominent parties in Westminster chose to abstain from the election, deeming it a mere political ploy. This by-election stemmed from Farage's prior resignation and his ambition to retake his seat.

title: Manav Suthar: The all-weather finger spinner India needs after Ravindra Jadeja
content: Manav Suthar is a classical left-arm spinner who stands out in modern cricket for his artistry, skill, and dedication. Praised by experts like Maninder Singh, Suthar impresses with his seamless action, wrist magic, and high revolutions on the ball. His adaptability and work ethic have earned him recognition in both domestic and international cricket, marking him as replacement for Ravindra Jadeja and an all-weather finger spinner.

title: BCI-NALSAR row: Who is Manan Kumar Mishra and why is he in spotlight?

Students have a right to protest, the Supreme Court observed on Friday.  The BCI's role in this matter was questioned by the apex court.  Proceedings were closed after considering various representations from the public.

title: White Ocean at 18,000 Feet: How the IAF Contributed to Indian Victory in Kargil
content: Operation Safed Sagar began with challenges in high-altitude combat and unguided bombing accuracy.  The introduction of Mirage 2000 aircraft with laser-guided bombs proved decisive.  These precision strikes helped recapture key positions like Tiger Hill.  The campaign demonstrated air power's precision and political discipline simultaneously.  Lessons learned continue to shape India's future air combat planning.

title: 800 kmph in 5.3 seconds: China train sets third record in six months
content: China's experimental maglev train achieved 800 kmph in just 5.3 seconds. This remarkable acceleration sets a new world record for short-distance travel. The technology is not intended for passenger transport due to extreme acceleration levels. Instead, it may find future uses in rocketry and military aircraft. Researchers are exploring its potential for industrial transport and specialized elevators.

title: From Safed Sagar to Sindoor: Renaissance of Indian Airpower
content: Operation Safed Sagar showed Indian air power's Kargil War improvisations.  Operation Sindoor in 2025 demonstrated a transformed, decisive air force.  Technological advancements and improved training fueled this significant transformation.  Joint doctrinal maturity and political resolve also played crucial roles.  Indian air power is now a strategic instrument shaping outcomes at speed.

title: DU Result 2026 out: Delhi University releases UG, PG semester results, check direct link
content: Delhi University has released the 2026 UG and PG semester examination results on its official examination portal. Students can access their marksheets by entering the required credentials, including their roll number and course details. The result document contains subject-wise marks, grades, total marks and result status. Candidates should carefully verify all details after downloading.

title: US lost 45 Reaper drones in Iran war, representing 25% fleet worth $1.3 bn: Report

This figure not only highlights a considerable depletion of their fleet but also signifies a financial hit exceeding one billion dollars. The drones have been heavily deployed around the Strait of Hormuz, revealing their susceptibility.

title: 'Astronauts' land on road craters: Over 100 Jaipur residents stage unique protest
content: Gokulpura residents staged a protest on Pratap Circle Road, highlighting poor road conditions. Two individuals dressed as astronauts entered water-filled potholes, simulating a lunar landscape. This unusual demonstration aimed to draw attention to neglected infrastructure and drainage issues. Residents have sought attention from local officials for several months regarding these problems. Tenders for road and drainage work have been awarded and will commence after the monsoon.

title: Jimmy Rimmer dies at 78: Football world mourns Manchester United legend
content: Former Manchester United and Aston Villa goalkeeper Jimmy Rimmer has passed away at seventy-eight. He was a European Cup winner with both clubs during his long career. Rimmer was part of Manchester United's historic 1968 European Cup-winning squad. He later became a key player for Aston Villa in their 1982 campaign. The club confirmed his death and paid tribute to the veteran goalkeeper.

title: Sauce Gardner’s $1.4 million Detroit property lawsuit takes dramatic new turn
content: Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner has initiated legal proceedings against a contractor based in Detroit. This lawsuit arises from a botched apartment renovation project, where Gardner alleges fraud and the misuse of his identity in marketing efforts. He demands not only the refund of renovation payments but also additional compensation. This off-field conflict marks a notable chapter in Gardner’s career.

title: Colorado expands habitat protection for endangered Preble's jumping mouse
content: Colorado is taking significant steps to ensure the survival of the endangered Preble's meadow jumping mouse. Efforts focus on restoring essential streamside ecosystems and linking them to floodplains. Landowners are invited to join this initiative through voluntary conservation measures and financial support. A conservation bank was established in 2024 to facilitate these vital restoration projects, with new initiatives rolling out in 2026 to enhance habitat safeguarding.

title: Cyber fraud probe over Rs 36,000 cannot block entire bank account, says Allahabad HC
content: The Allahabad high court ruled banks should not fully block accounts during cyber fraud investigations.  Only the specific disputed amount should be frozen, allowing access to remaining funds.  The court emphasized clear communication channels for customers with blocked accounts.  This directive aims to balance investigations with legitimate financial activities of individuals.  Banks must now inform customers about grievance redressal mechanisms for frozen accounts.

title: Mitchell Starc surpasses Kapil Dev as Australia face Bangladesh nightmare
content: In a remarkable achievement, Mitchell Starc outstripped Kapil Dev's wicket tally during the opening Test against Bangladesh, now boasting 435 Test wickets, positioning him eleventh on the all-time list. Meanwhile, Tanzid Hasan Tamim made history by scoring his first Test century in Australia. As the second day concluded, Bangladesh enjoyed a 150-run advantage, placing Australia in a tough spot to stay competitive in the series.

title: South Korea unveils housing package to boost supply and support young buyers

The government plans to provide enhanced support for construction financing, allowing for market stabilization. Furthermore, fresh lending facilities will be available for youth and newlywed couples looking to secure their dream homes.

title: Trust paid £3,000 to save Shakespeare's birthplace from being shipped to US
content: In the 1840s, Shakespeare's birthplace in Stratford-upon-Avon faced the threat of sale, as American showman P.T. Barnum aimed to move the historic home to New York. A dedicated committee formed, rallying public donations and support from notable figures like Prince Albert to save the site. Their efforts culminated in the successful acquisition of the house at auction in 1847, ensuring the preservation of this cherished cultural landmark.

title: Indian-origin man rejected for H-1B 3 times finds another way to stay in US
content: Sohan Sethi faced multiple H-1B visa rejections after arriving in the United States. He then pursued an O-1 visa, requiring extensive documentation and lawyer fees. Sethi demonstrated extraordinary ability through achievements and industry recognition to secure his stay. This path highlights the challenges faced by skilled professionals seeking to remain in America. He now manages a team, sharing his experience to guide others through the process.

title: Iran prez to visit India for BRICS summit amid Middle East tensions

Araghchi made the remarks during his visit to India in June. He said Tehran did not see a military solution to the conflict and believed that negotiations offered only viable way forward.

title: New York aquarium study suggests beluga whales may recognise themselves
content: four female beluga whales, three adults named Kathy, Marina and Natasha, were exposed to a large two-way plexiglass mirror and a transparent control surface . the researchers recorded and analysed their behavioural responses across 98 mirror sessions .
